description: Two stacked 7-DOF SRS arms on a humanoid torso hold one box. humanoid-ik: the 1 kHz firmware alone (object trajectory, damped-least-squares IK with a null-space pull toward home and an elbow bias, per arm, and an ideal-SRS pair), checked tick by tick against its numpy twin and against the interactive page's own IK. humanoid-ik-6dof: J5 locked, the stacked arms run into the J3 and J6 limits and miss the pose by about 3.5 mm and 3.3 deg. humanoid-hold: the dynamic multibody arms (illustrative masses, bond-graph drives, PID servos) carry the box on stiff grasp springs; the forward kinematics of the start posture, the 2 mm / 2 deg hold, the elbow self-motion under the bias and the power balance. humanoid-hold-6dof: the same with J5 locked. Generated by design/build_expected.py.
